schema_note: v4.3 实施卡片五要素（当前基线 — 准入条件 — 责任角色 — 验收指标 — 退出机制）；全部为概念建议/设计目标值，责任主体待协商指定，验收指标待专项深化正式化。退出机制默认采用 switchback（分段可逆）原则。

cards.current_baseline_zh: 概念设计；公开报道显示部分节点已有市级或区级立项批复（来源待登记复核）
cards.current_baseline_en: Concept design; public reporting indicates some nodes have municipal/district approvals (pending registry review)
cards.responsible_roles_zh: 属地主管部门 + 实施主体（待协商指定）+ 运营方
cards.responsible_roles_en: Local authority + implementing body (to be named) + operator
acceptance_metrics_zh: 投诉响应时长满足 P3
cards.exit_mechanism_zh: 分段可逆：未达标段按折返协议退回上一稳定状态并公示
cards.exit_mechanism_en: Segment-wise reversible: non-compliant segments revert under Switchback Protocol with public explanation
